import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
    
    static class mod_int {
        int val;
        
        mod_int(long v) {
            if (v < 0) v = v % MOD + MOD;
            if (v >= MOD) v %= MOD;
            val = (int) v;
        }
        
        mod_int() { val = 0; }
        
        mod_int(mod_int other) { val = other.val; }
        
        static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g; g = r; r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x; x = y; y = temp;
            }
            if (x < 0) x += m;
            return x;
        }
        
        mod_int add(mod_int other) {
            int newVal = val + other.val;
            if (newVal >= MOD) newVal -= MOD;
            return new mod_int(newVal);
        }
        
        mod_int subtract(mod_int other) {
            int newVal = val - other.val;
            if (newVal < 0) newVal += MOD;
            return new mod_int(newVal);
        }
        
        mod_int multiply(mod_int other) {
            long prod = (long) val * other.val;
            return new mod_int(prod % MOD);
        }
        
        mod_int divide(mod_int other) {
            return multiply(other.inv());
        }
        
        mod_int inv() {
            return new mod_int(modInverse(val, MOD));
        }
        
        mod_int pow(long p) {
            mod_int a = this;
            mod_int result = new mod_int(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(a);
                a = a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
        
        mod_int negate() {
            return val == 0 ? new mod_int(0) : new mod_int(MOD - val);
        }
        
        int intValue() { return val; }
        
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            mod_int mod_int = (mod_int) o;
            return val == mod_int.val;
        }
        
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        mod_int[][] probability = new mod_int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = sc.nextInt();
                probability[i][j] = new mod_int(p).divide(new mod_int(100));
            }
        }
        
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>(N + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }
        
        HashMap<Long, mod_int> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(1L << lookup[0], new mod_int(1));
        
        mod_int ONE = new mod_int(1);
        
        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            HashMap<Long, mod_int> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            mod_int[] products = new mod_int[1 << N];
            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                mod_int prod = new mod_int(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if (((current >> right) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(ONE.subtract(probability[left][right]));
                    }
                }
                products[current] = prod;
            }
            
            for (Map.Entry<Long, mod_int> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey();
                mod_int prob = entry.getValue();
                long[] newBits = new long[N];
                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if ((possible & (1L << lookup[mask])) != 0) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                newBits[i] |= (1L << lookup[mask | (1 << i)]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];
                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current)];
                    mod_int add = prob.multiply(products[current]);
                    newPossibleMasks.merge(newPossible[current], add, (a, b) -> a.add(b));
                }
            }
            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            System.err.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }
        
        mod_int answer = new mod_int(0);
        for (Map.Entry<Long, mod_int> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if ((entry.getKey() & (1L << lookup[(1 << N) - 1])) != 0) {
                answer = answer.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.intValue());
    }
}
